footnotes.text: If a subject loses ≥ 1 line (≥ 5 letters) of CDVA or DCNVA compared with Hour 0 of the same study visit at Hour 1 after dosing, a manifest refraction should be repeated under the same lighting conditions.

footnotes.text: Conducted with subject's best distance correction. Half-eye style trial frames with full field trial lenses only.

footnotes.text: Distance, photopic. Minimum 30-minute wait after administration of dilating drops.
footnotes.classificationReasoning: Specifies minimum wait time (30 minutes) after dilating drops, creating scheduling constraint for when assessment can occur.

footnotes.text: Investigator should note if the pupil dilated normally. Minimum 30-minute wait after administration of dilating drops.
footnotes.classificationReasoning: Multi-label: Creates scheduling constraint (30 minute wait) AND provides operational instruction about noting pupil dilation.

footnotes.text: Blood collection for PK at selected sites (on Days 1 and 14 at Hours 0, 0.25, 0.5, 1, 3, 6 [pre-dose], 6.25, 6.5, 7, 9, and 12). Collection windows of ± 5 minutes should be used for Hours 0.25, 0.5, 6.25, and 6.5; and collection windows of ± 15 minutes should be used for all other blood collection timepoints. Predose samples must be drawn within 15 minutes of the dosing time.
footnotes.classificationReasoning: Specifies detailed timing windows and constraints for PK sample collection across multiple timepoints, affecting visit scheduling.

footnotes.text: Hour 0 starts after study drug administration. Second dose should be applied within 15 minutes after Hour 6. Site staff will administer study drug during study visits. Subjects will administer the study drug at home in between visits.
footnotes.classificationReasoning: Multi-label: Creates timing constraints for drug administration (15 minute window) AND provides operational instructions about who administers drug.

footnotes.text: Conducted 5 to 10 minutes post-dosing. Only those who reported ocular discomfort symptom(s) will be further queried on the severity and duration of each symptom.
footnotes.classificationReasoning: Multi-label: Creates timing constraint (5-10 minutes post-dose) AND conditional logic for additional queries based on symptoms reported.
